_comment: A synthetic subject: same real repo/commit/tree binding as no-contracts.json, but the declared path list adds path STRINGS that are not files present in this tree (api/order.proto, buf.yaml) to demonstrate applicability detection over a hypothetical consumer repo that does carry Protobuf/Buf artifacts. detect_applicability matches by name only and never opens these paths, so no such files need to exist on disk for this fixture to be honest about what it tests.
